_readme: Lot analyses looked up by js/site.js on the home page. Add a real lot by
adding an object to `lots` keyed by its code, exactly as printed on the bag.
No code change is needed; the page fetches this file at runtime.
EVERY LOT BELOW IS A DEMO. The three codes and every number in them are
invented so the lookup can be exercised before real analyses exist. They
carry `"placeholder": true`, which the page shows as a visible flag.
Delete them when the first real lot is added.
grade            fine | medium | coarse (matches data/grades.json slug)
bagged, sampled  ISO dates, YYYY-MM-DD; the page formats them for display
lab              testing lab as it should appear on the page
method           the analysis methods, shown under the lab name
rows             ordered label/value pairs shown as the analysis table;
keep the order mineralogy, CaCO3, moisture, residue, density
sieve            ordered band/percent-retained pairs, coarsest band first;
placeholder      true on demo lots only; omit on real ones

code_format.explained: AC, then year and month (YYMM), then grade letter F/M/C and a two-digit run number.
